parties: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited; Axiro Semiconductor Private Limited; Tosil Systems Private Limited
headline: CG Power announces execution of definitive agreement for acquisition of Tosil Systems by Axiro Semiconductor
sum: CG Power and Industrial Solutions disclosed to NSE the execution of a definitive agreement for Axiro Semiconductor Private Limited to acquire Tosil Systems Private Limited, marking entry into a semiconductor/industrial tech target.
implication: Disclosure of execution (vs. LOI) signals material binding obligation; review whether consideration, earn-outs, or regulatory conditions were disclosed to market or are held in confidential schedules.
detail: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited informed the NSE Exchange on 17 August 2026 of the execution of a definitive acquisition agreement (binding stage, not exploratory) whereby Axiro Semiconductor Private Limited is acquiring Tosil Systems Private Limited. The announcement does not specify deal value, consideration structure, or closing conditions in the public disclosure. The transaction appears to be within the semiconductor or industrial solutions subsector based on the named parties.
